key_derivation: Enumerated from the workflow triggers, which is exhaustive by construction: `ls .github/workflows` lists 16 files and grepping their `on:` blocks shows exactly five that run on pull_request — build.yml:9, lint.yml:12, gh-pages.yml:8, mutation-tests.yml:8, code-ql.yml and dependency-review.yml. Mapping each to its config: lint.yml:44-52 actionlint + zizmor (persona pedantic, repo config .github/zizmor.yml) over the workflow YAML, lint.yml:54-75 PSScriptAnalyzer over every .ps1 with treat-warnings-as-errors; gh-pages.yml:31-38 markdownlint-cli2 with .markdownlint.json over **/*.md, gh-pages.yml:
